connector.name: AgentDM: Agent to Agent Communication Platform
connector.registryDescription: Agent communication platform for agent to agent messaging via MCP. Messages, channels, skills.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.agentdm.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.agentdm, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Recommended: OAuth 2.0. Omit this header and your MCP client will discover /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and run browser-based authorization (tokens auto-refresh for 30 days, no keys to copy). Alternative: API key. Send 'Bearer agentdm_<token>' from https://app.agentdm.ai for server-to-server use.
